AcCounts.description: Passing and total acceptance criteria, and how many are owner steps.
AcCounts.title: AcCounts

ActivityItem.description: A notable event in the activity feed.
ActivityItem.title: ActivityItem

Actor.description:
Who acted in a session (S2): the main agent, or a subagent of a type.

A subagent carries its ``agent_id`` and, when its start is linked to the main agent's
Agent tool call, that call's ``description`` and ``started_by_event_id``.
Actor.title: Actor

Approval.description:
An approval. ``decided`` once a matching result exists; ``inferred`` when the decision is
deduced (a guard ask with no tool run before the next prompt or stop is declined).

``how_to_decide`` is the terminal command that answers it, since Phase 2 is read-only:
``cd <hub path> && claude --resume <session id>``.
Approval.title: Approval

ApprovalKind.description: The kinds of request D24 lists.
ApprovalKind.title: ApprovalKind

CollectorStatus.description: ``GET /collector/status``: what ``hub web`` received and stored since it started.
CollectorStatus.title: CollectorStatus

EventSource.description: Where an event comes from; with ``source_id`` it identifies the event.
EventSource.title: EventSource

EventType.description: The closed list of event types in the SPEC; widening it later is a compatible change.
EventType.title: EventType

FeatureDetail.description: A feature with its acceptance criteria rows and its records (D3).
FeatureDetail.title: FeatureDetail

FeatureRecord.description:
One record file of a feature folder; ``path`` is relative to the hub's ``brain/``, so the
brain note route reads it.
FeatureRecord.title: FeatureRecord

FeatureView.description: A feature as the Features list shows it; ``problem`` when a file of it is malformed.
FeatureView.title: FeatureView

FindingView.description: A finding of a registered hub's doctor run.
FindingView.title: FindingView

HookAccepted.description: ``POST /events/hooks``: how many events the envelope added and how many were known.
HookAccepted.title: HookAccepted

HookDecision.description: What the guard or the Stop gate decided, sent with the hook input that caused it.
HookDecision.title: HookDecision

HookEnvelope.description:
Version 1 of the sensor's envelope.

``project`` comes from the hub's ``hub.json``; ``repo`` from the hook's cwd (a repo checkout
or one of its worktrees), else None; ``run``, ``step`` and ``attempt`` from the variables
``hub run`` sets for its session. ``hook`` is the Claude Code hook input as received, with
oversized strings already omitted by the sensor.
HookEnvelope.title: HookEnvelope

HubCreate.description: ``POST /hubs``: the absolute path of a hub to register.
HubCreate.title: HubCreate

HubView.description:
A registered hub as read now.

``valid`` is false when ``hub.json`` is unreadable or does not match the schema
(``validation_errors``). A pin other than the running version is read anyway and shows as
a warning ("pinned X, running Y").
HubView.title: HubView

IssueRef.description: The tracker issue a run works on; title and url need Linear (``null`` in Phase 2).
IssueRef.title: IssueRef

Learning.description:
A learning; ``text`` is its title (120 characters at most, redacted).

``target`` is deprecated (it names the inbox note); ``note_path`` says so explicitly (L12).
``state`` is ``None`` until read with the hub. ``summary`` is the note's first paragraph,
read on request; ``note_unavailable`` and ``actions_unavailable`` give the reason the note
cannot be read or the learning cannot be accepted or rejected here.
Learning.title: Learning

LearningState.description:
Where the learning's note is (L11): in the inbox, in an open PR, or moved by a merge.

``in_brain`` and ``archived`` are inferred from the hub checkout (the note sits at its
destination), since GitHub is not connected.
LearningState.title: LearningState

LearningStatus.description: Where a learning is: proposed until a terminal event in source order decides it.
LearningStatus.title: LearningStatus

LearningTarget.description: Where a learning would go: team brain, a repo's AGENTS.md, or personal memory.
LearningTarget.title: LearningTarget

LiveTile.description:
A session tile of the Live sessions screen.

``agent`` is deprecated (``label`` and ``actors``); ``needs_you_problem`` is the owner-facing
line of the first problem that needs the owner ("Needs you: <kind> in <where>").
LiveTile.title: LiveTile

NeedsYouItem.description: A verb-first line of the Needs you list.
NeedsYouItem.title: NeedsYouItem

Outcome.description: How an ended session ended; ``None`` when no source says.
Outcome.title: Outcome

ProblemCounts.description:
A session's problems by owner-facing status (S4, E5); ``handled`` = recovered or
continued by the agent.
ProblemCounts.title: ProblemCounts

ProblemDetails.description: An RFC 9457 problem; extension members (``errors``) are allowed.
ProblemDetails.title: ProblemDetails

ProjectNow.description: ``brain/now.md`` split into its sections; ``problem`` when it cannot be read.
ProjectNow.title: ProjectNow

ProjectSummary.description:
A Portfolio card: hub config plus the project's activity; PRs and issues need sources
not connected in Phase 2 (``null``).
ProjectSummary.title: ProjectSummary

PullRequestRef.description: A pull request; GitHub is not connected in Phase 2, so sessions carry ``null``.
PullRequestRef.title: PullRequestRef

RepoView.description: A repo of the project as ``hub.json`` and its checkout describe it.
RepoView.title: RepoView

RunCaps.description: The limits a run started with.
RunCaps.title: RunCaps

RunFailure.description: Where and why a run failed, and the event to open ("Open failing moment").
RunFailure.title: RunFailure

RunGateResult.description: A gate the executor ran (``gate_ok`` or a failed check).
RunGateResult.title: RunGateResult

RunStep.description: One step attempt, keyed ``(key, attempt)``; a loop back into verify is attempt 2.
RunStep.title: RunStep

SearchHit.description: A search result over ids, paths, commands and tool names; never payload bodies.
SearchHit.title: SearchHit

Session.description:
A session folded from its events (status, counts, tokens, estimated cost).

``agent`` is deprecated: ``actors`` and ``label`` say who acted and what the session is about.
Session.title: Session

SessionCost.description: The Cost tab: per-turn series and totals, always "Estimated from transcript" (D15).
SessionCost.title: SessionCost

SessionFileChange.description: A path a session touched, its operations and line counts (no content is stored).
SessionFileChange.title: SessionFileChange

SessionLabel.description:
What a session is about, derived on read (S1): issue, workflow, repo and branch.

``issue`` is ``<TEAM>-<n>`` found in ``branch`` or ``worktree`` with the hub's tracker teams,
else ``None``, never a guess. ``workflow`` is the session's main slash command or skill
(``/feature``); ``workflows`` lists every one in order. ``worktree`` is the folder name under
``.claude/worktrees/`` in the session's ``cwd``.
SessionLabel.title: SessionLabel

SessionSegment.description: One stretch of a session; a later event after an end reopens it as a new segment.
SessionSegment.title: SessionSegment

SessionStatus.description: Where a session is now (D14): waiting wins over live; ended is final until reopened.
SessionStatus.title: SessionStatus

SessionSummary.description: 3 to 5 deterministic lines (D17); a stored ``session.summary`` event wins (``stored``).
SessionSummary.title: SessionSummary

SettingsView.description: Read-only settings of the running ``hub web`` (no ``PATCH`` in Phase 2).
SettingsView.title: SettingsView

SourceStatus.description: When a source last sent an event, and whether that is recent enough.
SourceStatus.title: SourceStatus

Stage.description: A state of the run's machine; any stage before ``REPORTED`` can end in ``FAILED``.
Stage.title: Stage

SummaryLine.description: One line of a session summary and the event it comes from.
SummaryLine.title: SummaryLine

TimelineEvent.description:
One stored event as the timeline and Raw events show it.

``fact_key`` groups copies of the same fact from several sources; ``merged_sources`` lists
them on the winner; a loser has ``conflict`` set (D16). ``latency_ms`` is ``received_at``
minus ``timestamp`` when both exist.
TimelineEvent.title: TimelineEvent

TokenUsage.description: Tokens counted from transcript usage, once per message id.
TokenUsage.title: TokenUsage

TurnCost.description: Tokens and estimated cost of one turn.
TurnCost.title: TurnCost

ValidationProblem.description: One problem of a hub's ``hub.json``, located by a JSON pointer.
ValidationProblem.title: ValidationProblem

WorkflowRun.description: A run folded from executor events (D9, D16): the first ``run.end`` wins.
WorkflowRun.title: WorkflowRun
